name: gap_to_vwap_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps and continues to deviate 20+ basis points below (or above) the developing session VWAP, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms — index fund rebalancers, derivatives book delta-hedgers, and program traders tracking VWAP as their execution benchmark — begin accumulating against the gap direction to keep fills close to their VWAP target. On NIFTY, where these institutional flows are dominant and continuous, this creates a measurable first convergence thrust of 15-25 spot points within 60-90 seconds once RSI exhaustion signals the selling (or buying) pressure has peaked. At 5-second resolution we enter as the EMA(5) micro-cross confirms the institutional absorption has begun, capturing the first leg rather than waiting for the full VWAP touch. NIFTY's high liquidity and continuous two-sided institutional order flow make these reversion thrusts faster and more reliable than the original single-stock implementation.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP is cumulative — no lookback period. This is the gravitational attractor that institutional VWAP-benchmarked orders target. Cumulative from 09:15 IST each day.

indicators.name: vwap_dev_bps
indicators.purpose: Current deviation from session VWAP in basis points. At NIFTY 24000, 20 bps = 48 spot pts. This is the threshold above which institutional VWAP reversion flow becomes compelling enough to generate a measurable first-leg thrust within 60-90s.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Day-level gap computed once per session. Required to confirm VWAP deviation is gap-driven (institutional directional flow after overnight news) versus intraday drift. Gap-driven deviations revert faster because the institutional imperative to fill near VWAP is strongest when it was the gap itself that caused the deviation, not an intraday trend.

indicators.name: rsi_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars = 60 seconds RSI. Original used RSI(10) on 1-min = 10-minute RSI. We compress to 1-minute because at 5s bars with 30-90s holds, we need RSI to reflect the CURRENT short-term exhaustion state (last 60 seconds of momentum), not the prior 10 minutes. This is the entry trigger confirming that the gap-extension selling or buying has exhausted in the immediate term, signaling imminent reversion.

indicators.name: ema_5
indicators.purpose: 5 bars = 25-second micro EMA. Original used EMA(5) on 1-min = 5-min average. We compress dramatically because our entry trigger is 5s scale. A close crossing above/below the 25s EMA is the fastest reliable confirmation that the first institutional absorption bar has printed. Shorter would be too noisy (1-2 bar flips); longer would delay entry past the best fill.

conditions: close crosses above ema_5 from below (micro-upswing confirmation)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions must be true simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

conditions: vwap_dev_bps > vwap_dev_threshold (still above VWAP by 20+ bps)
close crosses below ema_5 from above (micro-downswing confirmation)
buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions must be true simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 spot pts further deviation from VWAP at delta 0.5. If NIFTY moves 8 more spot pts away from VWAP after entry, the institutional VWAP reversion we are betting on is not materializing on our timescale — the gap is extending into a trend and we must exit. Typical NIFTY 30-60s move is 2-5 option pts, so 4 pts gives enough room for one failed attempt while capping tail risk.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 spot pts convergence toward VWAP at delta 0.5. On NIFTY, the first institutional absorption thrust from a 20+ bps gap deviation typically covers 15-25 spot pts within 60-90 seconds. Targeting 14 spot pts (7 option pts) captures ~70% of the median first leg, well within the 1-2 minute typical convergence window. This gives a 1:1.75 risk-reward at the 4 pt stop.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 20; above 20, VWAP deviations widen and mean reversion takes longer than 90s, degrading the time-stop performance
filters.time_filter: 09:30-14:15 IST; first 15 min excluded because developing VWAP is VWAP heavily biased by gap open volume; afternoon excluded because gap-driven institutional VWAP pressure dissipates after 14:00
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is consistently liquid intraday
filters.trend_filter: implicitly handled by vwap_dev_bps condition — if NIFTY has been trending away from VWAP all day, the deviation threshold will be exceeded for hours and no entry will fire without RSI exhaustion
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit orders at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — VWAP benchmarking is structural to institutional execution and will persist; gap-to-VWAP on NIFTY index is driven by program trading flows that are algorithmic and persistent

adaptation_notes: Original was stock-universe with 1-min bars, 10-60 min hold. Key changes: (1) Applied to NIFTY index only — the institutional VWAP-benchmark flow is even stronger on the index than individual stocks because index funds and futures arbitrageurs must execute against NIFTY VWAP constantly; (2) Hold time compressed from 10-60 min to 30-90s — we capture only the FIRST leg of reversion, entering earlier via the EMA(5) micro-cross rather than waiting for a full 1-min bar confirmation; (3) RSI compressed from 10-period 1-min bars to 12-period 5s bars (= 60s RSI) to match our trigger timescale; (4) EMA compressed from 5-period 1-min to 5-period 5s bars (25s) for fastest reliable micro-cross; (5) VIX filter strengthened to 20 (original allowed 20) because at 5s bars, high VIX sessions produce slow, grinding reversion not fast 90s thrusts; (6) Session window narrowed to 09:30-14:15 IST — first 15 min excluded because early VWAP is unreliable (original identified same weakness), afternoon excluded because gap institutional urgency dissipates.
weaknesses: On strong trend days where NIFTY opens gap-down and keeps falling, institutional VWAP algos may be overridden by directional macro flow, producing false reversion signals
The EMA(5) micro-cross at 25 seconds can fire multiple times in consolidation, triggering multiple entries before the real reversion begins; max_trades_per_day=6 limits damage
Early in the session (09:30-10:00), the developing VWAP is still being anchored by gap volume, making vwap_dev_bps readings noisy and potentially too generous as a threshold
Gap-to-VWAP logic requires a meaningful gap (>0.2%) to fire; on flat-open days the strategy will trade infrequently, leading to low statistical confidence on any given day

_source.original_stop: vwap_dev_bps exceeds 40bps against position OR 0.4% from entry
